panel.summary: New `exportSlidesPptxAndDownload` ships with no test at all
panel.evidence: The new frontend export path (blob MIME `application/vnd...presentationml.presentation`, `safeFilename(title,"pptx")`, and the `fetchImage` adapter that wraps `docsImageFetcher` and falls back to `mime: "image/png"` when `blob.type` is empty) has no test. I globbed all frontend test files (`packages/frontend/**/*{test,spec}*`) — there is no `pptx-actions`, `pdf-actions`, `docx-actions` or `export-utils` test; grep for `exportPptx` finds tests only in `packages/slides/test/export/pptx/*` and `packages/cli/test/slides-export.test.ts`, which exercise the library/CLI paths, not this adapter. The adapter's own logic (arrayBuffer→Uint8Array, mime fallback, progress forwarding) is therefore uncovered and can regress silently; frontend also has no tsc lane, so nothing checks it.
panel.finding_key: packages/frontend/src/app/slides/pptx-actions.ts::new `exportslidespptxanddownload` ships with no test at all
